title: Comparisons (B1): 多了 / 得多, 还 / 更, 有…那么, 越来越, 一点儿也不, 跟…比
description: Much more, even more, 'as … as' questions with 有, more and more, not at all, and 'compared with'.

points.title: 比 … adj + 多了 / 得多: much more
points.summary: A 比 B + adj + 多了 / 得多 = much more …. Not ~~很 + adj~~ after 比.
points.body:
- 今天比昨天冷**多了**.
- 他比我高**得多**.
examples: Today is much colder than yesterday.

points.title: 比 … 还 / 更 + adj: even more
points.summary: 比 + B + 还 / 更 + adj = even more ….
examples: The younger brother is even taller than the older one.

points.title: A 有 B (那么) + adj (吗)?
points.summary: A 有 B 那么 + adj = A is as … as B (often in questions or negatives: 没有 B 那么 …).
examples: Are you as tall as your brother?

points.title: 越来越 + adj (+ 了): more and more
points.summary: 越来越 + adj/verb = more and more …. No 很 after it.
examples: {他|tā}{的|de}{中文|Zhōngwén}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{好|hǎo}{了|le}。
His Chinese is getting better and better.

points.title: 一点儿也 / 都 + 不 + adj: not at all
points.summary: 一点儿也不 + adj = not … at all.
points.body: - 这个电影**一点儿也不**好看.

points.title: 跟 A 比，B …: compared with A
points.summary: 跟 A 比(起来)，B 比较 / 更 + adj = compared with A, B is ….
examples: Compared with Beijing, Shanghai is fairly warm.

questions.prompt: {今天|jīntiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuótiān}{冷|lěng}（　），{多|duō}{穿|chuān}{点儿|diǎnr}{衣服|yīfu}{吧|ba}。
notes: 冷太多 isn't natural.
得很 can't follow a 比 comparison.
多很 isn't grammatical.
questions.translation: Today is much colder than yesterday — put on more clothes.

notes: No 很 in a 比 comparison.
多 goes after the adjective.
The order is 得多.

questions.prompt: {哥哥|gēge}{已经|yǐjīng}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}{了|le}，{可是|kěshì}{弟弟|dìdi}{比|bǐ}{哥哥|gēge}（　）{高|gāo}。
notes: 最 can't be used with 比.
很 can't be used with 比.
非常 can't be used with 比.
questions.translation: The older brother is already tall, but the younger one is even taller.

questions.prompt: {今天|jīntiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuótiān}（　）{热|rè}，{已经|yǐjīng}{三十八|sānshíbā}{度|dù}{了|le}。
notes: 真 can't be used with 比.
太 can't be used with 比.
很 can't be used with 比.
questions.translation: Today is even hotter than yesterday — it's already 38 degrees.

notes: 有 … 很高 isn't a comparison.
最 can't be used here.
非常 can't be used here.
questions.translation: Are you as tall as your brother?

notes: 有 comes first.
那么 goes before the adjective.
那么 comes after B.
questions.translation: Are you as tall as him?

questions.prompt: {秋天|qiūtiān}{到|dào}{了|le}，{天气|tiānqì}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}（　）{了|le}。
notes: 更 is redundant after 越来越.
No 很 after 越来越.
Reduplication doesn't fit.
questions.translation: Autumn is here — it's getting colder and colder.

options: {他|tā}{的|de}{中文|Zhōngwén}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{了|le}。
{他|tā}{的|de}{中文|Zhōngwén}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{好|hǎo}{了|le}。
{他|tā}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{的|de}{中文|Zhōngwén}{好|hǎo}{了|le}。
notes: No 很 after 越来越.
The order is 越来越 + adj.
越来越 goes before the adjective.
questions.translation: His Chinese is getting better and better.

questions.prompt: {这个|zhège}{电影|diànyǐng}{一点儿|yìdiǎnr}{也|yě}{不|bù}（　），{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{了|le}{一半|yíbàn}{就|jiù}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: Not at all: **一点儿也不 + adj**.
notes: 好看了 doesn't fit.
No 很 after 一点儿也不.
不太好看 = 'not very good' — but 一点儿也不太 isn't grammatical.
questions.translation: This film wasn't good at all — I left halfway through.

notes: The order is 也不.
不 goes right before the adjective.
一点儿也 needs a negative.
比 needs a second noun after it.
比起 needs a noun after it.
Not grammatical.
questions.translation: Compared with Beijing, winters in Shanghai are fairly warm.

options: {跟|gēn}{去年|qùnián}{比较|bǐjiào}，{今年|jīnnián}{的|de}{夏天|xiàtiān}{热|rè}{更|gèng}。
notes: 更 goes before the adjective.
比 needs a noun after it.
The order is 跟 … 比.
questions.translation: Compared with last year, this summer is even hotter.
